game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Wall Battlements, the high battlements: the squire must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against bandits.
theme: The Kingdom – Wall Battlements: the high battlements
core_gameplay_loop: In Wall Battlements, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against bandits. Each round, bandits strike the granary door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the potion value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the granary door from bandits in Wall Battlements: keep the potion meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: potion drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Wall Battlements'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Wall Battlements.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while potion > 0.
